statements.illustrative: Every ASSUMED or SYNTHETIC value in this file is an illustrative demonstration default. None is supported by observed business data, and none may be presented as a verified business fact.
statements.discount_uplift: The +1.6% per discount point figure is a statistical association observed in apparently synthetic historical data. It is not a causal effect and not an elasticity. It must not be used to promise, forecast or report additional sales, revenue or margin. It is used only to check whether a markdown could plausibly reduce a projected surplus within the safety limits, and the result is always presented for human approval.
statements.demand: Recorded weekly sales are treated as illustrative demand; they are not verified unconstrained demand. Simulated unmet units are illustrative and are never observed lost sales.
statements.uncertainty: Planning weights interpolate between the forecast contract's p50 and p90. They are heuristics, not calibrated stockout probabilities; targets above 90% are unsupported and capped at p90 (extrapolation disabled).
statements.fulfilment: Expected fulfilment (planning_fill_rate_pct, 100%) is a planning assumption known at the decision. Realised receipts (delivery_fill_rate_pct, over_delivery_pct_short_life) are SYNTHETIC simulated outcomes applied only on the arrival day and are never read by planning.
statements.status: DRAFT: not approved, not validated against business data and not for production use. Every simulated order, delivery and outcome is hypothetical, unapproved and not executed.
statements.information_boundary: Parameters are configuration only: none is derived from sales, deliveries or outcomes after a decision date.
statements.waste_risk: Waste-risk classes describe SIMULATED stock projected against FORECAST demand under ASSUMED parameters. They are advisory, hypothetical and never a measurement of real waste. Recorded historical wastage is shown only as separate historical context.
statements.markdown_review: Markdown review eligibility only says whether a person should look at a line. It never proposes a discount size or a new price, never predicts sales, margin or waste effects, and never approves or executes anything. Eligibility rests on SIMULATED stock, FORECAST demand and ASSUMED rules.
statements.pricing_demonstration: DEMONSTRATION ONLY: illustrative prices, costs and rules. The base price is an estimated reference-price proxy and the cost follows an assumed margin. Figures are arithmetic and rule checks; no sales response, elasticity, waste reduction or profit change is modelled, and no option is recommended, proposed, approved or executed.
statements.discount_recommendation: SIMULATED RESEARCH RECOMMENDATION - NOT VALIDATED FOR LIVE USE. The engine ranks permitted markdown steps for lines eligible for markdown review under explicitly ASSUMED demand-response scenarios. The responses are not estimated causal elasticities; the central 1.6% per point value is the non-causal historical association and is used only as one stated scenario. Prices are an estimated reference-price proxy, costs follow an assumed margin, stock and expiry are SIMULATED and demand is FORECAST. Nothing is proposed, approved or executed, and no result may be presented as a forecast of extra sales, reduced waste or improved profit.
statements.dynamic_pricing: SIMULATED RESEARCH - NOT VALIDATED FOR LIVE USE. Weekly markdown decisions are simulated inside the inventory replay. Orders are fixed to the pricing-off pass, so pricing never changes ordering. Prices never exceed the reference price. The response used to SELECT a markdown (v6 decision weights) is kept separate from the response used to SIMULATE what happens (one true-response scenario per run, including no response). Every markdown is recorded as SIMULATED, HYPOTHETICAL_UNAPPROVED and NOT_EXECUTED and is applied in the simulation only as if approved. No result may be presented as proven commercial benefit.
statements.cooldown_amendment: Amendment A1: the dynamic_pricing_cooldown_days (7) are complete days counted from the END of the previous simulated markdown window for the same store-product. A new markdown may start only on or after previous window end + 7 + 1. This replaces the v7 selection-day basis for runs made with v8; the v7 rule and every result made with it are preserved unchanged. The rolling 2-in-28-days limit and the no-overlap rule are kept.
statements.waste_interventions: ADVISORY INVESTIGATION SUPPORT ONLY. Waste-intervention options are classified from saved simulated, forecast and assumed evidence. No order change, transfer, markdown, donation or disposal is assumed to have happened, proposed for execution or approved. Stock transfer and donation or disposal are INVESTIGATE ONLY: distance, transport, cost, receiving capacity, batch stock, food safety, eligibility and recipients are unknown. Values at risk are illustrative (estimated retail value and assumed cost value), never savings. The investigation order follows evidence quality, not financial benefit, and is not a commercially optimal choice.

review_rules.case_unit: store x product x origin week (one case per decision point; reasons aggregated)
mandatory_escalation: CHRISTMAS_PERIOD (any H1 or H4 target week 51 or 52)
warnings: LIFE_LEAD_TIME_TIGHT (escalates only together with a material trigger)
review_rules.coverage: Pre-order coverage: usable stock plus deliveries committed before the decision, over the days before the new order can arrive (identifies shortage pressure). Post-order coverage: the same plus the proposed order on its scheduled arrival days, over the 7-day coverage window (shows whether the order addresses the pressure). Both are heuristic positions against forecast quantiles, not stockout probabilities.
review_rules.approval: No proposed action is approved or executed without an explicit approval event. Simulated orders and outcomes are hypothetical and unauthorised.
review_rules.holiday: HOLIDAY_TARGET_WEEK is a flag and a priority boost only; it never creates a case on its own
